title: Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda Eligibility Limits at Sale
content:
# Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — Eligibility Limits at Sale

Each waiver of the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda is offered only on a vehicle purchase financed by a dealer-arranged installment contract. The Kessler GAP Commercial 130 is the waiver for a fleet business buyer; the other five are for individual buyers. Within that entry, the limits below decide whether a given deal may carry a given waiver.

## Entry and term limits

| Waiver | Buyer | Contract term (months) | Waiver term equals contract term | Amount financed (USD) | Highest waiver price (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler GAP Waiver 125 | individual | 24 to 72 | Yes | 5000.00 to 60000.00 | 695.00 |
| Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 | individual | 24 to 72 | Yes | 5000.00 to 50000.00 | 795.00 |
| Kessler GAP Waiver 150 | individual | 24 to 84 | Yes | 7500.00 to 100000.00 | 895.00 |
| Kessler GAP Plus 150 | individual | 24 to 84 | Yes | 7500.00 to 100000.00 | 995.00 |
| Kessler GAP Plus 175 | individual | 24 to 84 | Yes | 10000.00 to 150000.00 | 1195.00 |
| Kessler GAP Commercial 130 | fleet business | 24 to 60 | Yes | 10000.00 to 125000.00 | 1095.00 |

## Vehicle limits and counts

| Waiver | Vehicle conditions accepted | Greatest vehicle age at sale (years) | Commercial use covered | Lease accepted | Active waivers per vehicle | Total-loss claims paid per waiver | Waiver follows an assumed contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler GAP Waiver 125 | new, certified pre-owned, used | 10 | No | No | 1 | 1 | No |
| Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 | used, certified pre-owned | 10 | No | No | 1 | 1 | No |
| Kessler GAP Waiver 150 | new, certified pre-owned, used | 7 | No | No | 1 | 1 | No |
| Kessler GAP Plus 150 | new, certified pre-owned, used | 7 | No | No | 1 | 1 | No |
| Kessler GAP Plus 175 | new | 1 | No | No | 1 | 1 | No |
| Kessler GAP Commercial 130 | new | 1 | Yes | No | 1 | 1 | No |

## Meaning of each limit

- **Contract term** — the shortest and longest installment contract term the waiver may be sold on; where the waiver term must equal the contract term (Yes for every waiver), the waiver runs exactly as long as the contract.
- **Amount financed** — the smallest and largest amount financed the waiver may be sold on.
- **Highest waiver price** — the most the waiver may be sold for.
- **Vehicle conditions accepted** — the vehicle conditions the waiver may be sold on.
- **Greatest vehicle age at sale** — counted as the sale year less the model year.
- **Commercial use covered** — whether a vehicle in commercial use may be covered.
- **Lease accepted** — whether the waiver may be attached to a lease; it may not, for any waiver.
- **Active waivers per vehicle** — the most active waivers one vehicle may carry.
- **Total-loss claims paid per waiver** — the most total-loss claims one waiver pays.
- **Waiver follows an assumed contract** — whether the waiver passes to another borrower who assumes the contract; for every waiver it does not.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical deals)

- A used vehicle of model year Year 1 sold in Year 8 is 7 years old at sale: inside the limit of the Kessler GAP Waiver 150, and equally inside the 10-year limit of the Kessler GAP Waiver 125. Sold in Year 9 it is 8 years old and outside the Kessler GAP Waiver 150 limit.
- An amount financed of 4,990.00 is below every waiver's floor; one of 52,400.00 is inside the Kessler GAP Waiver 125 range and above the Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 ceiling.
